output:
To: Bethan Rees
Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!

Beth,

Just replying to you, not getting into it on the group email. I’ve just landed off a Lagos so bear with me if this comes out a bit muddled.

I know things have been awkward with Lowri since her 40th in November, and that reply won’t have helped. I’m not going to pick through who said what about her ex or tell either of you off. Things were said on both sides. I do think she’s probably sorry underneath it, but neither of you finds backing down easy, do you.

Would you think about coming just for Saturday? Leave the Friday at the cottage if that feels too much. You only need to get to Tenby for 6, then we’ve got the meal at 7.30. Train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours, I think, and I’ll pick you up from the station. You can kip in with me Saturday night, I’ve got the twin room. No need to make a whole weekend of it or pretend everything’s sorted.

I swapped my Orlando with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, lost a night stop I really wanted too. Not saying that to make you feel bad, just that I really wanted us all there for Nia, you included.

She rang me crying last week asking whether you were still coming. She doesn’t know you’ve pulled out yet. You’re the one who sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019, Beth. You matter to her, and she wants you there.

I keep thinking about you doing your reading at Margam on 17th April. I’d hate for you to get there and wish you’d come to the hen after all. Nia would really miss you on the Saturday, even with something lovely sent separately.

Don’t send Lowri any money yet. Have a sleep on it and let’s have a chat when I’ve had one too. Just Saturday, for the meal, with me?

Siân xx
